4011c1.surface: API staff routes (reservation, guest, settings, admin user operations)
4011c1.evidence: Reviewed the route handlers and middleware: authenticated handlers call requireVenueAccess against the resource venue before returning or mutating data; admin and super-admin mutations additionally enforce requireAdmin or an explicit super-admin check.

7510ac.evidence: Reviewed reservation creation, lookup, cancel, and feedback handlers. All database access uses Prisma model methods or tagged `$queryRaw`/`$executeRaw` templates with interpolated values parameter-bound; no unsafe raw-query API or dynamic query syntax found.

72ff04.surface: API public reservation and venue endpoints
72ff04.risk_area: SQL injection and unsafe input handling
72ff04.evidence: Public route inputs are handled through Prisma filters or parameterized tagged raw SQL; request schemas constrain key identifiers and booking fields, and custom table-selection validation checks venue membership before mutation.

f7cdb4.evidence: Reviewed public venue, availability, and table-availability handlers; they use Prisma `findUnique`/`findMany` with structured filters. Date/time and integer inputs feed domain conversion and parameterized ORM fields, not SQL syntax.

9a7461.risk_area: CSRF, session validation, and CORS policy
9a7461.evidence: Static review found HTTP-only Secure SameSite=Lax session cookies and configured-origin CORS checks for unsafe methods, but cannot establish whether deployed origin configuration includes attacker-controlled sibling origins or validate browser behavior without deployment config/runtime.

bf3a4f.surface: API public reservation and venue handlers
bf3a4f.evidence: These handlers perform database CRUD and domain date/time calculations only. No outbound URL fetch, XML parser, filesystem path operation, template evaluator, or command execution sink is present in the reviewed routes.

3b6668.evidence: `requestedTableArea`, `claimTable`, `assertAreaCapacity`, and `pickAreaForParty` use Prisma structured filters or tagged `$queryRaw` templates; all values (venue, area, date bounds) remain bound parameters and no raw-unsafe calls are present.

efb5f0.surface: apps/web/pages/[venue]/ index and server sitemap/llms, useVenueSeo
efb5f0.evidence: Changed JSON-LD paths serialize application/API values with '<' escaped in useVenueSeo before script insertion; homepage JSON-LD only uses static VENUE_SEO literals. sitemap and llms outputs use static configured URLs and slugs; booking navigation uses fixed configured path and URLSearchParams, not attacker-supplied destination.

3476a4.risk_area: XSS / unsafe URL scheme / open redirect
3476a4.evidence: Reservation fields render via Vue interpolation; calendar link is constructed from API fields as encoded data:text/calendar URL, and venue links come from fixed routing. Feedback review URL is static VENUE_SEO config; external links use noopener.

100141.surface: apps/web changed UI components, booking/host/admin pages and composables
100141.risk_area: XSS / DOM sinks / CSRF / SSRF / open redirect
100141.evidence: Reviewed changed UI templates and searched runtime sources for v-html, innerHTML, document.write, window.open, navigation and dynamic href sinks. No attacker-controlled HTML sink or arbitrary destination was identified; dynamic values use Vue interpolation, external navigation destinations are configured/static, WhatsApp phone values are digit-filtered.

1df266.risk_area: Known dependency CVEs introduced by PR
1df266.evidence: The inherited diff scope lists a modified root pnpm-lock.yaml, but the mounted workspace contains only /workspace/api and /workspace/web and no root checkout or lockfile; Trivy therefore found zero language-specific manifests in either mounted subtree, so changed dependency versions cannot be verified.

9555e5.surface: Changed docs, configuration, report artifacts and committed secret-bearing files (api/web)
9555e5.risk_area: Newly introduced secrets or unsafe deployment configuration
9555e5.evidence: Reviewed mounted API/web .gitignore and existing gitleaks/trufflehog artifacts; no verified credential material is present in those reports. Local .env files exist but are excluded by .gitignore and diff membership could not be checked because the git checkout is not mounted.

98b331.surface: apps/web auth store, API composables, login and host-route middleware
98b331.evidence: Reviewed cookie-based API requests and login redirect handling. `pages/login.vue` accepts `next` only when it starts with one slash and not `//` or backslash, preventing external/protocol-relative redirects; `useApi.ts` uses credentials include without exposing bearer tokens to browser storage.

618a89.risk_area: Frontend authorization/IDOR via selected venue and route/query parameters
618a89.evidence: Follow-up API review confirmed the corresponding staff handlers independently enforce requireAuth, requireVenueAccess, and role checks; frontend-selected venue IDs cannot bypass server authorization.

history.evidence: Frontend pages pass venueId from query/localStorage and rely on backend enforcement; API source is outside this assigned validation slice, so cross-venue authorization must be verified at API handlers.

fa5b49.surface: Nuxt admin and host page role middleware
fa5b49.evidence: Changed pages apply auth middleware and admin middleware; backend staff handlers independently call requireAuth/requireVenueAccess/requireAdmin (e.g. /staff/day, /admin/analytics), so client routing isn't the sole authorization control.

7b6ede.evidence: Page uses cookie-authenticated /api/staff/guests/{id}; corresponding API fetches guest then calls requireVenueAccess(session, guest.venueId) before returning guest profile/reservations.

973500.evidence: The destination accepts only strings beginning with a single `/` and explicitly rejects slash/backslash as the second character; navigation uses router.push, preventing absolute and protocol-relative external destinations.

628845.surface: Auth store and API composable session handling
628845.evidence: Session is sent as an HttpOnly cookie via credentials:include; frontend stores user profile and selected venue ID only, not session credentials.

854aab.evidence: API handler requires authenticated session and requireVenueAccess(session, guest.venueId) before loading reservations; frontend route itself cannot bypass this server-side check.

eca01a.evidence: Each API handler calls requireAuth, resolves venueId, requireVenueAccess, then requireAdmin; client selectedVenueId is therefore not trusted for access.

83ff8a.evidence: Although the handler maps reservation bookingCode/id/guestId internally, response returns only `{date,timeZone,slots}`; getDayAvailability consumes the internal rows and does not include identifiers. No booking code reaches the public response or cancellation/feedback routes.

history.evidence: Endpoint serializes every reservation's bookingCode, reservation ID, guest ID, and metadata into a public availability response; validator is checking whether leaked booking codes enable unauthorized cancellation/feedback and whether this behavior is introduced by the diff.

39b1d6.risk_area: Unauthenticated disclosure of reservation identifiers/booking codes enabling guest cancellation or feedback
39b1d6.evidence: The route maps database rows to objects containing bookingCode/id/guestId locally, but passes these only to getDayAvailability; that helper returns per-time availability slots and never exposes reservation objects or those fields. Response is explicitly `{ date, timeZone, slots }`. Thus no leaked bookingCode can reach the public cancel/feedback endpoints.

a45daa.surface: Staff reservation and guest routes (`/staff/day`, `/staff/reservations/*`, `/staff/guests/*`, staff exports)
a45daa.evidence: Each object lookup derives its venueId from the persisted reservation/guest before `requireVenueAccess`; venue-scoped list/export routes call `staffVenue` then `requireVenueAccess` and constrain Prisma queries by that venue.

15f6e9.surface: Admin venue settings, opening hours, closed dates, analytics, feedback, reservations, exports
15f6e9.evidence: All venue-admin handlers call `requireAuth`, `requireVenueAccess`, and `requireAdmin`; super-admin-only global handlers (`/admin/venues`, `/admin/users`, `/admin/audit-log`) explicitly require `session.user.isSuperAdmin`.

a3878e.surface: Floor-plan routes (`/admin/venues/:id/floor-plan`, layout/image mutations, public floor-plan read)
a3878e.evidence: Layout mutation requires venue access plus venue role `admin`; image mutation is restricted to super-admin; all Prisma reads/writes are constrained by the requested venueId, with cross-venue area IDs rejected.

238f9e.evidence: Login requires active user and Argon2 password verification, creates cryptographically random session token stored only as SHA-256 hash, and validation checks expiry and active status; logout deletes the hashed token.

ac1243.evidence: Pages expose only booking details returned by public API using high-entropy booking code as bearer link; no client-side cross-user identifier is accepted. External links use rel=noopener; route code is not rendered as raw HTML.

4a8fdb.evidence: Host UI sends selected venue/date and reservation IDs, while API /staff/day, status changes, and exports require authenticated session and venue access; selectedVenueId is not an authorization control.
